entities.summary: Serge Élie Ayoub, also known under the alias Batskin, is a French political activist associated with the far-right and formerly the hooligan movement. Serge Ayoub was a activists & reformers from Bagnolet (b. 1964-10-28, Bagnolet). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
